picks.thesis: Convergence is the cleanest in this dossier: eleven TSM officers, including Chairman/CEO Wei Che-Chia and EVP/Co-COO Mii Yuh-Jier, bought on 2026-06-05 with no 10b5-1 plan flagged and filings four days later; VP Yuan Lipen added 79,190 on 06-22. Six congressional purchases across four members (Fields, Cisneros, Letlow, Allen) run January through May, every one in the 1,001-15,000 band. Honest caveats: the insider dollar amounts are small in absolute terms (3,040-11,402 apart from Yuan), and the congressional leg is stale — the latest buy was 2026-05-08, filed 39 days later. Price context: last close 401.28, -7.75% over 30 days, close to the 90-day low of 391.4233.
key_risks: Insider purchase sizes are small relative to senior-executive pay; ten of the eleven are under 12,000 and may reflect routine participation rather than conviction
All eleven insider buys share a single transaction date (2026-06-05), so they are not eleven independent decisions
The congressional leg is decayed — nothing disclosed after a 2026-05-08 transaction — and every band is the minimum 1,001-15,000
Disclosure bands are ranges, not sizes; the congressional exposure could be near 1,001 in each case
picks.invalidation: Insider buying stops or reverses to sales while price breaks below the 90-day low of 391.4233, or the congressional buyers file offsetting sales.
